links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses versus recommended sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: All models exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level, and all Flesch Reading Ease scores remained below the easy-to-read threshold.
links.quote: ChatGPT-o3 and DeepSeek-V4 demonstrated relatively favorable readability on different indices; however, all models exceeded the recommended sixth-grade reading level, and all Flesch Reading Ease scores remained below the easy-to-read threshold.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of chatbot patient education output
links.effect: All four models exceeded sixth-grade reading level; none consistently produced sufficiently accessible information.
links.quote: Although some models provided comparatively stronger patient education, none consistently produced sufficiently accessible information.

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, readability, and transparency of responses from multiple LLM chatbots to patient education queries about robot-assisted radical prostatectomy without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
